nameOrigin: spinning top on which it’s based

pokedexEntries.go: If you become enchanted by its smooth, elegant, dance-like kicks, you may get drilled hard.

pokedexEntries.si: It launches kicks while spinning. If it spins at high speed, it may bore its way into the ground.

pokedexEntries.cr: After doing a handstand to throw off the opponent’s timing, it presents its fancy kick moves.

pokedexEntries.rs: HITMONTOP spins on its head at high speed, all the while delivering kicks. This technique is a remarkable mix of both offense and defense at the same time. The POKéMON travels faster spinning than it does walking.
